Key.Original: Air Defense - Eradicate Hostile Rotary Threat
Key.English: Air Defense - Eradicate Hostile Rotary Threat
Key.French: Défense Aérienne - Neutraliser la Menace d'Hélicoptères
Key.Italian: Difesa aerea - Eliminare gli elicotteri d'attacco nemici
Key.Korean: 대공 방어 - 적 공격 헬리콥터 격퇴
Key.Japanese: 防空戦闘 - 敵攻撃ヘリコプター部隊の殲滅
Key.Chinese: 防空作戰 - 圍剿敵軍武裝直升機
Key.Chinesesimp: 防空作战 - 围剿敌军武装直升机
Key.Turkish: Hava Savunma - Düşman Taarruz Helikopterlerini İmha Edin

Key.Original: Hostile attack helicopters are operating at low level supporting ground assault operations. Ingress rapidly, engage with air-to-air missiles or cannon and eliminate all hostile helicopters. Ground troops are present but their elimination is not required.
Key.English: Hostile attack helicopters are operating at low level supporting ground assault operations. Ingress rapidly, engage with air-to-air missiles or cannon and eliminate all hostile helicopters. Ground troops are present but their elimination is not required.
Key.French: Des hélicoptères de combat ennemis opèrent à basse altitude en appui des opérations terrestres. Intervenez rapidement, engagez aux missiles air-air ou au canon et éliminez tous les hélicoptères cibles. Des troupes au sol sont présentes mais leur destruction n'est pas requise.
Key.Spanish: Helicópteros de ataque enemigos operan a baja cota. Enlace con misiles aire-aire o cañón y derribe todos los helicópteros. No es necesario abatir a la infantería.
Key.German: Feindliche Kampfhubschrauber fliegen im Tiefflug zur Unterstützung der Bodentruppen. Schießen Sie alle Hubschrauber ab. Bodentruppen müssen nicht eliminiert werden.
Key.Italian: Elicotteri d'attacco nemici operano a bassa quota. Abbattete tutti gli elicotteri con missili o cannone. La distruzione della fanteria a terra non è richiesta.
Key.Polish: Śmigłowce bojowe wroga operują na małej wysokości. Zniszcz wszystkie wrogie śmigłowce rakietami lub działkiem. Piechota naziemna nie musi być zniszczona.
Key.Portuguese: Helicópteros de ataque inimigos operam a baixa altitude. Abata todos os helicópteros inimigos. A destruição das tropas terrestres não é exigida.
Key.Russian: Ударные вертолеты противника действуют на малой высоте. Уничтожьте все вертолеты ракетами «воздух-воздух» или пушкой. Ликвидация пехоты на земле не требуется.
Key.Czech: Nepřátelské bojové vrtulníky operují v nízké výšce. Sestřelte všechny vrtulníky střelami nebo kanónem. Likvidace pozemních jednotek není vyžadována.
Key.Korean: 적 공격 헬기가 지상 작전을 지원하며 초저고도로 비행 중입니다. 신속히 진입하여 공대공 미사일이나 기관포로 모든 헬기를 격추하십시오. 지상 보병 섬멸은 필수가 아닙니다.
Key.Japanese: 敵攻撃ヘリが超低空で地上支援を実施している。迅速に進出し、空対空ミサイルまたは機関砲ですべての敵ヘリを撃墜せよ。地上部隊の撃破は必須ではない。
Key.Chinese: 敵軍武裝直升機正於超低空活動以支援地面部隊。請迅速切入戰區，以空對空飛彈或航砲擊落所有敵方直升機。地面部隊無須清剿。
Key.Chinesesimp: 敌军武装直升机正于超低空活动以支援地面部队。请迅速切入战区，以空对空导弹或航炮击落所有敌方直升机。地面部队无须清剿。
Key.Turkish: Düşman taarruz helikopterleri alçak irtifada kara harekâtını destekliyor. Hızla intikal edin ve tüm helikopterleri vurun. Yer birliklerini imha etmek zorunlu değildir.

Key.Original: Victor-One, Overlord. Enemy attack helicopters operating at tree-top level near grid %1. Hunt them down.
Key.English: Victor-One, Overlord. Enemy attack helicopters operating at tree-top level near grid %1. Hunt them down.
Key.French: Victor-One, ici Overlord. Des hélicoptères de combat ennemis volent au ras des arbres près de la grille %1. Chassez-les et détruisez-les.
Key.Spanish: Victor-One, aquí Overlord. Helicópteros enemigos operando al ras de los árboles en cuadrícula %1. Cácelos.
Key.German: Victor-One, hier Overlord. Feindliche Kampfhubschrauber fliegen im Wipfelflug bei Gitter %1. Jagen und vernichten Sie sie.
Key.Italian: Victor-One, qui Overlord. Elicotteri d'attacco nemici operano a filo d'albero vicino alla griglia %1. Date loro la caccia.
Key.Polish: Victor-One, tu Overlord. Śmigłowce bojowe wroga lecą tuż nad koronami drzew przy siatce %1. Zlikwiduj je.
Key.Portuguese: Victor-One, aqui Overlord. Helicópteros inimigos voando a baixa altitude perto da grade %1. Cace-os.
Key.Russian: Виктор-Один, я Оверлорд. Ударные вертолеты противника идут на бреющем у сетки %1. Устраните угрозу.
Key.Czech: Victor-One, zde Overlord. Bojové vrtulníky nepřítele letí těsně nad stromy u sítě %1. Zničte je.
Key.Korean: 빅터-원, 여기는 오버로드. 적 공격 헬기가 그리드 %1 인근에서 초저공 비행 중입니다. 격추하십시오.
Key.Japanese: ビクター1、こちらオーバーロード。グリッド %1 付近を超低空で飛行する敵攻撃ヘリを確認。直ちに急襲し撃墜せよ。
Key.Chinese: 勝利一號，這裡是霸王。網格座標 %1 附近有敵武裝直升機正進行超低空掠地飛行。予以獵殺消滅。
Key.Chinesesimp: 胜利一号，这里是霸王。网格坐标 %1 附近有敌武装直升机正进行超低空掠地飞行。予以猎杀消灭。
Key.Turkish: Victor-One, ben Overlord. %1 koordinatı yakınlarında düşman taarruz helikopterleri alçaktan uçuyor. Vurun onları.

Key.Original: Victor-One, Overlord. Rotary threats down! Helicopter assets eradicated.
Key.English: Victor-One, Overlord. Rotary threats down! Helicopter assets eradicated.
Key.French: Victor-One, ici Overlord. Menaces à voilure tournante abattues ! Hélicoptères ennemis anéantis.
Key.Spanish: Victor-One, aquí Overlord. ¡Helicópteros abatidos! Amenaza erradicada.
Key.German: Victor-One, hier Overlord. Hubschrauber abgeschossen! Bedrohung ausgeschaltet.
Key.Italian: Victor-One, qui Overlord. Elicotteri abbattuti! Minaccia nemica eliminata.
Key.Polish: Victor-One, tu Overlord. Śmigłowce zestrzelone! Zagrożenie zlikwidowane.
Key.Portuguese: Victor-One, aqui Overlord. Helicópteros abatidos! Ameaça erradicada.
Key.Russian: Виктор-Один, я Оверлорд. Вертолеты сбиты! Воздушные цели уничтожены.
Key.Czech: Victor-One, zde Overlord. Vrtulníky sestřeleny! Hrozba zlikvidována.
Key.Korean: 빅터-원, 여기는 오버로드. 회전익 위협 격추 완료! 적 헬기 세력이 전멸했습니다.
Key.Japanese: ビクター1、こちらオーバーロード。敵回転翼機を全機撃墜！ヘリ戦力は壊滅した。
Key.Chinese: 勝利一號，這裡是霸王。敵旋翼機全數擊落！直升機威脅已消除。
Key.Chinesesimp: 胜利一号，这里是霸王。敌旋翼机全数击落！直升机威胁已消除。
Key.Turkish: Victor-One, ben Overlord. Düşman helikopterleri düşürüldü! Döner kanat tehdidi bertaraf edildi.
